# Surveillance reform scorecard (Restore the Fourth)

> Congressional grades on surveillance and privacy votes. Every grade is recomputable from the
> published dataset; scoring rules are public and experimentable.

Staging data is a demo: real members, votes and records, but vote directions are unreviewed
placeholders. Do not cite staging grades as Restore the Fourth positions.

## Data (JSON, no key)
- [Current publication](/scorecard/api/publications/latest): dataset (members, votes, records, rubric, sources) and frozen scores
- [Publication list](/scorecard/api/publications): immutable history; fetch one at /scorecard/api/publications/<id>

## Docs
- [Agent guide](https://github.com/RT4National/surveillance-scorecard/blob/main/docs/AGENT-GUIDE.md): data shape, scoring formula, experiment CLI, draft API
- [Scoring code](https://github.com/RT4National/surveillance-scorecard/blob/main/src/core/scoring.ts)
- [Methodology page](/scorecard/methodology)
